summary: Inception Growth Acquisition Ltd, a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting a $12,203.33 deposit into its trust account to extend the business combination deadline by one month from July 13, 2026 to August 13, 2026. No deal terms or target are disclosed; this is a routine extension to provide additional time to complete an acquisition. The filing includes a press release announcing the extension. As a SPAC with its units, common stock, warrants, and rights trading on OTC Markets, the focus is on the remaining time to close a merger before liquidation risk arises.
